title: Glitter Dream 2A
description:
An alpha version the the Glitter Dream 2 (Real name pending) pack!

Vanilla+ built around fun multiplayer interactions and Create!
body:
**Glitter Dream (Alpha) is here!**

A light vanilla+ modpack that expands base game mechanics while keeping them accessible. Glitter Dream develops key game elements like exploration, building, logistics, and atmosphere. We’ve also included a handful of fixes, UI improvements, and performance-enhancing mods like Sodium. 

**Features**

Improved UI for modded with custom menus, JEI, Blurred, and new in-game UI elements

New world generation and exploration with Geophilic, the YUNG’s Better series, and Artifacts

Fixes for known bugs and inconsistencies in vanilla

Lively ambiance with AmbientSounds 5 and enhanced natural environments

A more challenging survival environment with seasons and other world/player changes

More simple decor options with Supplementaries, Decorative Blocks, Chimes, and Bedspreads

Logistics with Create and more redstone devices

+===========================================================================+
